visuals.heading: Why This Decision Feels So Heavy

blocks.heading: Try One More Year, It Will Work

items.text: Anything other than IAS or IPS is settling for less.
You wasted your prep years if you do not clear the exam.
Just do an MBA or join any private job, direction does not matter.

blocks.heading: State PSC: the Closest Adjacent Path

items.text: State PSC is a lesser exam, only worth it if UPSC completely fails.
Preparing for both wastes time because they are unrelated syllabuses.
A state-level post is a step down from an all-India service.
Ask what actually changed between attempts, not just how hard they studied.
A family that has quietly funded three or four attempts deserves a clear number for what one more attempt will cost, not a vague sense that it will work out.
Separate the family's pride in the goal from the child's actual fit for the work.
Treat a pivot as a redirection, not a failure to be managed quietly.
